former_id: SCMPE_CONTROL_MANIFEST_CANDIDATE -- renamed under owner PATH A (audit 2026-08-31 section 5, amendment A2): the construction below yields ONE alternative taxonomy, not a Semantic-Cohesion-Matched Partition Ensemble; SCMPE-v1 (>=1000 balanced partitions, cohesion/separation/frequency/length/morphology matching, percentile reporting) is NOT implemented here and this control may never be called SCMPE
purpose: S7 (SINGLE_ALTERNATIVE_TAXONOMY): replace the task-aligned labels with one structured alternative annotation. Beating S7 shows the coupler benefit is not satisfied by this one alternative carving; it licenses NOTHING about CAS specificity.
status: CANDIDATE -- the frozen table MUST be constructed, balance-checked, and digest-pinned under the CONTAINER_PREP approval, BEFORE any activation extraction, training, or result exists; its digest enters the signed EXECUTION approval as s7_control_table_sha256 and the launcher re-verifies the constructed table on-instance
circularity_disclosure: the dataset's answer function is defined over the CAS classes, so every taxonomy admissible under the orthogonality rule is necessarily MISALIGNED with the answer function; no equally task-aligned non-CAS control can exist on this dataset (GATE1A_SCOPE_AND_CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md, honest ceilings)
cross_family_instability_disclosure: the head verbs change completely across template families (^2: drawn/pulled/felt/captured across A/B/C/D, etc.), so the taxonomy class of the SAME formal operation changes between train (A,B), validation (C), and protected (D) surfaces; S7's labels are therefore unstable across splits while S3's are stable -- a recorded structural handicap of this control (owner audit section 4 of the S7 finding). This is why S7 is a diagnostic control, never an equal comparison.

construction_law.resource: an INDEPENDENT FROZEN lexical resource -- WordNet 3.1 verb lexicographer files (lexnames) -- NOT the target Transformer's activations, NOT any model output
construction_law.resource_pinning: the WordNet 3.1 archive SHA-256 is recorded in this manifest before construction (slot below); the mapping table derived from it is frozen as derived/alternative_taxonomy_table.json with its own digest

head_verb_table.comment: the REGISTERED head verb per (class, family) -- complete 16-row table

construction_law.runtime_law: at training/eval time the label is read from the CLAUSE SURFACE (exec/labels.py s7_taxonomy_label finds the one registered verb in the clause text and maps verb -> class); the gold class is never consulted
construction_law.mapping_rule: each registered verb maps to its WordNet 3.1 primary-sense lexname; the four taxonomy classes are the four most populous distinct lexname groups over the 16 registered verbs; verbs in smaller groups join the lexname group of their nearest hypernym-path group, ties broken alphabetically by lexname (executable, no judgment calls)
construction_law.balance_tolerance: each taxonomy class covers 25% +/- 10% of clauses per split; if the tolerance fails, apply the registered EXECUTABLE fallback: repeatedly move the alphabetically-first verb of the largest class to the smallest class until the tolerance holds or 16 moves occur (then reject the taxonomy and use the registered noun-domain alternative); every move is recorded -- never hand-edited per clause
construction_law.orthogonality_check: the taxonomy class must NOT be a relabeling of the CAS class: Cramer's V between taxonomy and CAS labels over train must be <= 0.35, computed and recorded before Gate 1B training; if exceeded, the taxonomy is rejected and an alternative registered carving (noun-domain lexnames) is used and recorded

frozen_before_results_law: the final derived/alternative_taxonomy_table.json digest, the balance counts, and the orthogonality statistic are appended to this manifest and to the execution receipt BEFORE any arm result is computed; after the first protected read, this manifest is immutable
claim_language_law: S3 > S7 contributes ONE of the seven control gates required for TASK_ALIGNED_LABEL_AUXILIARY_VALUE_LICENSED (THRESHOLDS_AND_STATUS_LAW.yaml v3); the words 'CAS-specific' are PROHIBITED on this dataset regardless of result; a real specificity test requires SCMPE-v1 on a v2 dataset whose answer function is not class-bijective (owner PATH B, deferred)
